summary: OddOne presents a single full-auto team capable of clearing all 60 stages of the Season 9 Meander Trial. The core damage dealer is Talethia, supported by Anneliesis, Child of Chaos, Diantha, and Holfast. Talethia ideally requires at least Inspiration 2, whereas Anneliesis and Child of Chaos function well at base copies. Diantha and Holfast can be swapped out for other aura support heroes if needed.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Built with standard damage gear; works reliably when at least Inspiration 2.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Functions completely fine at base copy (Inspiration 0).

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Used as an aura support hero and can be substituted by other aura supports.

heroes.name: Holfast
heroes.note: Acts as an aura support hero and can be substituted by other aura supports.

heroes.name: Child of Chaos
heroes.note: Clears all 60 stages at base inspiration with no extra copies needed.

teams.note: Full-auto team that clears stages 1 through 60; Diantha and Holfast can be swapped for other aura supports, and only Talethia benefits significantly from Inspiration 2+.

tips: Aim for at least Inspiration 2 on Talethia for consistent full-auto clears, while keeping Anneliesis and Child of Chaos at base copies.
If missing Diantha or Holfast, swap them out for any other available aura support heroes.
